en.title: Nothing but the Blood
en.author: Robert Lowry
stanzas:
[G]What can wash away my [D]sin?
[D7]Nothing but the blood of [G]Jesus;
[G]What can make me whole a[D]gain?
[D7]Nothing but the blood of [G]Jesus.

For my pardon, this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my cleansing this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

Now by this I'll overcome—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus,
Now by this I'll reach my home—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

Glory! Glory! This I sing—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus,
All my praise for this I bring—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
en.chorus:
[G]Oh! precious [C]is the [G]flow
That makes me [D7]white as [G]snow;
[G]No other [C]fount I [G]know,
[D7]Nothing but the blood of [G]Jesus.

notes: Text is the Cyber Hymnal's six-stanza form (hymnary.org/hymn/CYBER/4498), Lowry's full original from Gospel Music, 1876. Many modern hymnals print only stanzas 1-4 (so hymnary's representative text, United Methodist Hymnal 1989, which also lowercases pronouns and begins the refrain 'O precious is the flow'). Chords: PLAINFIELD's tune page gives F Major, but G Major is equally common in print (Trinity Hymnal rev., The Celebration Hymnal) and is the guitar-friendly choice, so no transposition is implied. Chart is a plain I-V7 gospel harmonization. Independently checked against Timeless Truths (URL appended): same six stanzas, refrain, tune name, 7.8.7.8 R meter, and F as the printed key; wording matches throughout.
